# SPARQL queries

<!-- Generated by src/engine/queries/catalog.test.ts from src/engine/queries/catalog.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npm test -- -u`. -->

Every query the explorer sends, generated from the code that sends it. CI fails when this file
no longer matches the code, so what is written here is what the app runs.

Examples use Maine (state `23`, Cumberland and Penobscot counties `23005` and `23019`). Where a
step receives identifiers from an earlier step, they appear as `http://example.org/...`
placeholders. The PREFIX block is the same in every query, so it is left out and printed once
under [Prefixes](#prefixes).

This page shows 4 worked analysis questions. The catalog has 382
question shapes in all; print any of them with

```bash
npm run sparql                                   # list every entry
npm run sparql -- "wells upstream streams [ME on C]"
```

## Dropdowns

Each dropdown asks the graph what to offer, once per region per session (React Query,
`staleTime: Infinity`). The builder and endpoint for each one are paired in
`LOOKUPS` in `src/engine/lookupQueries.ts`.

### Industry

Sent from useIndustries in src/hooks/useDiscoveryQueries.ts.

#### On `fiokg`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?code ?label ?groupCode ?groupLabel WHERE {
  ?industryCode a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode ;
      rdfs:label ?label ;
      fio:subcodeOf ?group .
  ?group rdfs:label ?groupLabel .
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?industryCode), STR(naics:NAICS-), "") AS ?code)
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?group), STR(naics:NAICS-), "") AS ?groupCode)
} ORDER BY ?groupCode ?code
```

### Industry counts

Sent from useIndustryCounts in src/hooks/useDiscoveryQueries.ts.

#### State, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT ?industryCode (COUNT(DISTINCT ?facility) AS ?num) WHERE {
  VALUES ?_regionRoot { kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 }
  ?s2 rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 ;
      spatial:connectedTo ?_regionRoot ;
      kwg-ont:sfContains ?facility .
  ?facility fio:ofIndustry ?industryCode .
  ?industryCode a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .
} GROUP BY ?industryCode
```

#### Counties, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT ?industryCode (COUNT(DISTINCT ?facility) AS ?num) WHERE {
  VALUES ?_regionRoot { kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23005 kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23019 }
  ?s2 rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 ;
      spatial:connectedTo ?_regionRoot ;
      kwg-ont:sfContains ?facility .
  ?facility fio:ofIndustry ?industryCode .
  ?industryCode a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .
} GROUP BY ?industryCode
```

### Substance

Sent from useSubstances in src/hooks/useDiscoveryQueries.ts.

#### No region, on `sawgraph`

```sparql
SELECT ?substance
  (SAMPLE(?_label) AS ?label)
  (SAMPLE(?_short) AS ?short_label)
  (MIN(?_viaParam) AS ?param_label)
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?observation) AS ?num)
WHERE {

  ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;

               coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substance .
  ?substance a comptox:ChemicalEntity .
  OPTIONAL { ?substance rdfs:label ?_label . }
  OPTIONAL { ?substance skos:altLabel ?_short . }
  OPTIONAL { ?pL comptox:sameAsDSSToxSubstance ?substance ; rdfs:label ?_viaParam . }
} GROUP BY ?substance
ORDER BY DESC(?num) ?label
```

#### State, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT ?substance
  (SAMPLE(?_label) AS ?label)
  (SAMPLE(?_short) AS ?short_label)
  (MIN(?_viaParam) AS ?param_label)
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?observation) AS ?num)
WHERE {
  ?sp rdf:type coso:SamplePoint .

  ?sp spatial:connectedTo ?_region .
  ?_region rdf:type kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion_3 ;
           kwg-ont:administrativePartOf+ ?_regionRoot .
  VALUES ?_regionRoot { kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 }

  ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;
               coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp ;
               coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substance .
  ?substance a comptox:ChemicalEntity .
  OPTIONAL { ?substance rdfs:label ?_label . }
  OPTIONAL { ?substance skos:altLabel ?_short . }
  OPTIONAL { ?pL comptox:sameAsDSSToxSubstance ?substance ; rdfs:label ?_viaParam . }
} GROUP BY ?substance
ORDER BY DESC(?num) ?label
```

### Material

Sent from useMaterialTypes in src/hooks/useDiscoveryQueries.ts.

#### No region, on `sawgraph`

```sparql
  SELECT ?matType (SAMPLE(?_label) AS ?label) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?observation) AS ?num) (MIN(?prio) AS ?bucketPrio) WHERE {
    ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;
                 coso:analyzedSample ?sample .
    ?sample coso:sampleOfMaterialType ?matType .

OPTIONAL {
  ?sample rdf:type ?bucketClass .
  VALUES (?bucketClass ?prio) {
    (coso:BiotaSample 1)
    (coso:SolidMaterialSample 2)
    (coso:WaterSample 3)
    (coso:AirSample 4)
  }
}
    OPTIONAL { ?matType rdfs:label ?_label . }
    FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?matType), "http://w3id.org/"))
  } GROUP BY ?matType
  ORDER BY DESC(?num) ?label
```

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?county ?countyName WHERE {
```

### Well classification

Sent from useWellClassifications in src/hooks/useDiscoveryQueries.ts, three queries run together.

#### `illinoisWellPurposes`, on `hydrologykg`

```sparql
SELECT ?value (SAMPLE(?l) AS ?label) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?well) AS ?num) WHERE {
  ?well rdf:type il_isgs:ISGS-Well ; il_isgs:wellPurpose ?value .
  OPTIONAL { ?value rdfs:label ?l . }
} GROUP BY ?value ORDER BY DESC(?num)
```

#### `maineWellTypes`, on `hydrologykg`

```sparql
SELECT ?value (COUNT(DISTINCT ?well) AS ?num) WHERE {
  ?well rdf:type me_mgs:MGS-Well ; me_mgs:ofWellType ?value .
} GROUP BY ?value ORDER BY DESC(?num)
```

#### `maineWellUses`, on `hydrologykg`

```sparql
SELECT ?value (COUNT(DISTINCT ?well) AS ?num) WHERE {
  ?well rdf:type me_mgs:MGS-Well ; me_mgs:hasUse ?value .
} GROUP BY ?value ORDER BY DESC(?num)
```

## Sample popup

Sent from useSampleDetails in src/hooks/useSampleDetails.ts, when a sample popup opens. One sample point at a time.

#### No filters, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT
  ?sp ?spWKT
  (SAMPLE(?spName) as ?samplePointName)
  ?sample
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?sampleId; separator="; ") as ?sampleIdentifier)
  ?observation
  ?date
  ?substanceUri
  (SAMPLE(?shortLabel) as ?substanceShortLabel)
  (SAMPLE(?fullLabel) as ?substanceLabel)
  (MIN(?paramLabel) as ?substanceParamLabel)
  ?result_value
  ?unit_sym
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?matTypeLabel; separator=", ") as ?sampleType)
WHERE {
  VALUES ?sp { <http://example.org/samplepoint/1> }
  ?sp geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?spWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?sp rdfs:label ?spName }
  ?sample coso:fromSamplePoint ?sp ;
      coso:sampleOfMaterialType ?matType .
  ?matType rdfs:label ?matTypeLabel .
  ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;
      coso:analyzedSample ?sample ;
      coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp ;
      coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substanceUri ;
      coso:hasResult ?result .

  OPTIONAL { ?substanceUri skos:altLabel ?shortLabel }
  OPTIONAL { ?substanceUri rdfs:label ?fullLabel }
  OPTIONAL { ?sourceParam comptox:sameAsDSSToxSubstance ?substanceUri ;
                          rdfs:label ?paramLabel }
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?numericResult }
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue ?_qv .
             ?_qv rdf:type coso:NonDetectQuantityValue .
             BIND(true AS ?nonDetect) }
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?numericResult),
         IF(BOUND(?nonDetect), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_value)
  OPTIONAL { ?result coso:measurementUnit ?unit .
             OPTIONAL { ?unit qudt:symbol ?unit_sym0 } }
  BIND(COALESCE(?unit_sym0,
         IF(BOUND(?unit), REPLACE(STR(?unit), "^.*[#/]", ""), "")) AS ?unit_sym)
  OPTIONAL { ?observation sosa:resultTime ?date }
  OPTIONAL { ?sample dcterms:identifier ?sampleId }

}
GROUP BY ?sp ?spWKT ?sample ?observation ?date ?substanceUri ?result_value ?unit_sym
ORDER BY ?sp ?sample ?substanceUri DESC(?date)
```

#### With the question's sample filters (PFOS, detections only), on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT
  ?sp ?spWKT
  (SAMPLE(?spName) as ?samplePointName)
  ?sample
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?sampleId; separator="; ") as ?sampleIdentifier)
  ?observation
  ?date
  ?substanceUri
  (SAMPLE(?shortLabel) as ?substanceShortLabel)
  (SAMPLE(?fullLabel) as ?substanceLabel)
  (MIN(?paramLabel) as ?substanceParamLabel)
  ?result_value
  ?unit_sym
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?matTypeLabel; separator=", ") as ?sampleType)
WHERE {
  VALUES ?sp { <http://example.org/samplepoint/1> }
  ?sp geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?spWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?sp rdfs:label ?spName }
  ?sample coso:fromSamplePoint ?sp ;
      coso:sampleOfMaterialType ?matType .
  ?matType rdfs:label ?matTypeLabel .
  ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;
      coso:analyzedSample ?sample ;
      coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp ;
      coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substanceUri ;
      coso:hasResult ?result .
  VALUES ?substanceUri { <http://w3id.org/DSSTox/v1/DTXSID3031864> }

  OPTIONAL { ?substanceUri skos:altLabel ?shortLabel }
  OPTIONAL { ?substanceUri rdfs:label ?fullLabel }
  OPTIONAL { ?sourceParam comptox:sameAsDSSToxSubstance ?substanceUri ;
                          rdfs:label ?paramLabel }
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?numericResult }
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue ?_qv .
             ?_qv rdf:type coso:NonDetectQuantityValue .
             BIND(true AS ?nonDetect) }
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?numericResult),
         IF(BOUND(?nonDetect), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_value)
  OPTIONAL { ?result coso:measurementUnit ?unit .
             OPTIONAL { ?unit qudt:symbol ?unit_sym0 } }
  BIND(COALESCE(?unit_sym0,
         IF(BOUND(?unit), REPLACE(STR(?unit), "^.*[#/]", ""), "")) AS ?unit_sym)
  OPTIONAL { ?observation sosa:resultTime ?date }
  OPTIONAL { ?sample dcterms:identifier ?sampleId }
  FILTER(BOUND(?numericResult))

}
GROUP BY ?sp ?spWKT ?sample ?observation ?date ?substanceUri ?result_value ?unit_sym
ORDER BY ?sp ?sample ?substanceUri DESC(?date)
```

## Analysis questions

A question is two entity blocks and a relationship. `planPipeline` in `src/engine/planner.ts`
turns it into these steps, run in order by `src/engine/executor.ts`:

| Step | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `FIND_TARGET_IRIS` | Finds the identifiers of the entities the question is asking for. |
| `FIND_ANCHOR_IRIS` | Finds the identifiers of the entities on the other side of the relationship that matched. |
| `GET_FLOWLINE_GEOMETRIES` | Downstream and upstream only: the river segments connecting the two sides, drawn as the stream layer. |
| `HYDRATE_TARGET_BY_IRI` | Loads names, geometry and properties for the identifiers the first step found. |
| `HYDRATE_ANCHOR_BY_IRI` | The same for the other side. |
| `GET_REGION_BOUNDARIES` | The outline of the selected state or counties. Skipped when no region is set. |

When a step is too big to answer at once, the executor slices it (see [Probes](#probes)) and runs
the same query once per slice, with the slice pinned in a `VALUES` block.

### Samples near facilities in Maine

Catalog entry `samples near facilities [ME on A]`.

#### Step 1: Finding samples near facilities

`FIND_TARGET_IRIS` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?spC AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2target .
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
}
```

#### Step 2: Finding facilities with samples near them

`FIND_ANCHOR_IRIS` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?facilityA AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2target .
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
}
```

#### Step 3: Loading details for samples

`HYDRATE_TARGET_BY_IRI` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?observation) as ?resultCount)
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sample) as ?sampleCount)
  (MAX(?numericResult) as ?max)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?substance; separator="; ") as ?substances)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?matTypeLabel; separator="; ") as ?materials)
  (SAMPLE(?spName) as ?samplePointName)
  ?sp ?spWKT ?s2cell
WHERE {
  VALUES ?sp { <http://example.org/target/1> <http://example.org/target/2> }
  ?sp spatial:connectedTo ?s2cell ;
      geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?spWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?sp rdfs:label ?spName }
  ?s2cell rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;
      coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp ;
      coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substance ;
      coso:analyzedSample ?sample ;
      coso:hasResult ?result .
  ?sample rdfs:label ?sampleLabel ;
      coso:sampleOfMaterialType ?matType .
  ?matType rdfs:label ?matTypeLabel .

  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?numericResult }
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue ?_qv .
             ?_qv rdf:type coso:NonDetectQuantityValue .
             BIND(true AS ?nonDetect) }
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?numericResult),
         IF(BOUND(?nonDetect), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_value)

} GROUP BY ?sp ?spWKT ?s2cell
```

#### Step 4: Loading details for facilities

`HYDRATE_ANCHOR_BY_IRI` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?facility ?facWKT ?facilityName ?industryCode ?industryName ?s2cell WHERE {
  VALUES ?facility { <http://example.org/anchor/1> <http://example.org/anchor/2> }
  ?s2cell kwg-ont:sfContains ?facility ;
          rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?facility fio:ofIndustry ?industryCode ;
            geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?facWKT ;
            rdfs:label ?facilityName .
  ?industryCode a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode ;
                rdfs:label ?industryName .

}
```

#### Step 5: Loading region boundaries

`GET_REGION_BOUNDARIES` on `spatialkg`

```sparql
SELECT ?region (SAMPLE(?_name) AS ?regionName) (SAMPLE(?_wkt) AS ?regionWKT) WHERE {
  ?region kwg-ont:administrativePartOf kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 ;
          rdfs:label ?_name ;
          geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?_wkt .
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?region), STR(kwgr:)))
} GROUP BY ?region
```

### Samples downstream of facilities in Maine

Catalog entry `samples downstream facilities [ME on A]`.

#### Step 1: Finding samples downstream of facilities

`FIND_TARGET_IRIS` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?spC AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline .
  ?upstream_flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?ds_flowline .
  ?upstream_flowline rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

}
```

#### Step 2: Finding facilities with samples downstream of them

`FIND_ANCHOR_IRIS` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?facilityA AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline .
  ?upstream_flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?ds_flowline .
  ?upstream_flowline rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

}
```

#### Step 3: Loading downstream stream geometries

`GET_FLOWLINE_GEOMETRIES` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline ?flowlineWKT ?fl_type ?streamName WHERE {
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline WHERE {
      {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?s2cellus WHERE {
      VALUES ?facilityA { <http://example.org/anchor/1> <http://example.org/anchor/2> }

      ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
      ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

      ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2cellus .
    }
  }
      ?upstream_flowline rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath ;
        spatial:connectedTo ?s2cellus ;
        hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?flowline .
    }
  }
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline WHERE {
      {
        SELECT DISTINCT ?s2celltarget WHERE {
          VALUES ?spC { <http://example.org/target/1> <http://example.org/target/2> }

          ?s2celltarget rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
          ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2celltarget .
        }
      }
      ?_flTarget spatial:connectedTo ?s2celltarget .
      ?flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?_flTarget .
    }
  }
  ?flowline geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?flowlineWKT ;
            nhdplusv2:hasFTYPE ?fl_type .
  OPTIONAL { ?flowline rdfs:label ?streamName }
}
```

#### Step 4: Loading details for samples

`HYDRATE_TARGET_BY_IRI` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?observation) as ?resultCount)
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sample) as ?sampleCount)
  (MAX(?numericResult) as ?max)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?substance; separator="; ") as ?substances)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?matTypeLabel; separator="; ") as ?materials)
  (SAMPLE(?spName) as ?samplePointName)
  ?sp ?spWKT ?s2cell
WHERE {
  VALUES ?sp { <http://example.org/target/1> <http://example.org/target/2> }
  ?sp spatial:connectedTo ?s2cell ;
      geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?spWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?sp rdfs:label ?spName }
  ?s2cell rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;
      coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp ;
      coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substance ;
      coso:analyzedSample ?sample ;
      coso:hasResult ?result .
  ?sample rdfs:label ?sampleLabel ;
      coso:sampleOfMaterialType ?matType .
  ?matType rdfs:label ?matTypeLabel .

  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?numericResult }
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue ?_qv .
             ?_qv rdf:type coso:NonDetectQuantityValue .
             BIND(true AS ?nonDetect) }
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?numericResult),
         IF(BOUND(?nonDetect), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_value)

} GROUP BY ?sp ?spWKT ?s2cell
```

### Samples downstream of facilities in Maine, within 30 km of flow

Catalog entry `samples downstream(30km) facilities [ME on A]`.

#### Step 1: Finding samples downstream of facilities

`FIND_TARGET_IRIS` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?spC AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline .
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?upstream_flowline ?ds_flowline WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?ds_flowline ?_flEnd (SUM(?_flLen) AS ?_plen) WHERE {
          {
            SELECT ?ds_flowline ?_flMid ?_flEnd WHERE {
              { SELECT DISTINCT ?ds_flowline WHERE { ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline . } }
              ?_flMid hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?ds_flowline .
            ?_flEnd hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?_flMid .
            }
          }
          ?_flMid nhdplusv2:hasFlowPathLength/qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?_flLen .
        } GROUP BY ?ds_flowline ?_flEnd
      }
      FILTER (xsd:float(?_plen) < xsd:float(30))
      ?upstream_flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPath? ?_flEnd .
    }
  }
  ?upstream_flowline rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

}
```

#### Step 2: Finding facilities with samples downstream of them

`FIND_ANCHOR_IRIS` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?facilityA AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline .
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?upstream_flowline ?ds_flowline WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?ds_flowline ?_flEnd (SUM(?_flLen) AS ?_plen) WHERE {
          {
            SELECT ?ds_flowline ?_flMid ?_flEnd WHERE {
              { SELECT DISTINCT ?ds_flowline WHERE { ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline . } }
              ?_flMid hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?ds_flowline .
            ?_flEnd hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?_flMid .
            }
          }
          ?_flMid nhdplusv2:hasFlowPathLength/qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?_flLen .
        } GROUP BY ?ds_flowline ?_flEnd
      }
      FILTER (xsd:float(?_plen) < xsd:float(30))
      ?upstream_flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPath? ?_flEnd .
    }
  }
  ?upstream_flowline rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
```

#### Step 3: Loading downstream stream geometries

`GET_FLOWLINE_GEOMETRIES` on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline ?flowlineWKT ?fl_type ?streamName ?path_length WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?flowline (MIN(?_ptotal) AS ?path_length) WHERE {
      {
        SELECT ?_flSeed ?_flEnd (SUM(?_flLen) AS ?_plen) WHERE {
          {
            SELECT ?_flSeed ?_flMid ?_flEnd WHERE {
              {
                SELECT DISTINCT ?_flSeed WHERE {
                  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?s2cellus WHERE {
      VALUES ?facilityA { <http://example.org/anchor/1> <http://example.org/anchor/2> }

      ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
      ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

      ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2cellus .
    }
  }
                  ?_flSeed rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath ;
                           spatial:connectedTo ?s2cellus .
                }
              }
              ?_flSeed hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?_flMid .
              ?_flMid hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?_flEnd .
            }
          }
          ?_flMid nhdplusv2:hasFlowPathLength/qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?_flLen .
        } GROUP BY ?_flSeed ?_flEnd
      }
      FILTER (xsd:float(?_plen) < xsd:float(30))
      ?_flEnd nhdplusv2:hasFlowPathLength/qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?_endLen .
      ?_flEnd hyf:downstreamFlowPath? ?flowline .
      BIND(IF(?flowline = ?_flEnd, 0.0, ?_endLen) AS ?_extra)
      BIND(xsd:float(?_plen) + xsd:float(?_extra) AS ?_ptotal)
    } GROUP BY ?flowline
  }
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline WHERE {
      {
        SELECT DISTINCT ?s2celltarget WHERE {
          VALUES ?spC { <http://example.org/target/1> <http://example.org/target/2> }

          ?s2celltarget rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
          ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2celltarget .
        }
      }
      ?_flTarget spatial:connectedTo ?s2celltarget .
      ?flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?_flTarget .
    }
  }
  ?flowline geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?flowlineWKT ;
            nhdplusv2:hasFTYPE ?fl_type .
  OPTIONAL { ?flowline rdfs:label ?streamName }
}
```

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT
  (?wellC AS ?well) ?wellWKT (?s2target AS ?s2cell)
  ?wellName ?meUse ?meWellType ?meDepth ?meOverburden
  ?ilOwner ?ilDepth ?ilPurpose ?ilYield

      coso:hasResult ?resultA .

         IF(BOUND(?nonDetectA), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_valueA)

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2target .
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .

  { ?wellC rdf:type il_isgs:ISGS-Well } UNION { ?wellC rdf:type me_mgs:MGS-Well }
  ?wellC geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wellWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC rdfs:label ?wellName . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:hasUse ?meUse . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:ofWellType ?meWellType . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:wellDepth/qudt:numericValue ?meDepth . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:wellOverburden/qudt:numericValue ?meOverburden . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:hasOwner ?ilOwner . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:wellDepth/qudt:numericValue ?ilDepth . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:wellPurpose ?ilPurpose . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:wellYield/qudt:numericValue ?ilYield . }
}
```

## Probes

Sent from chooseAxis in src/engine/scope.ts, after a step times out. A probe lists up to 201 entities on one side of the question, which
decides whether the work can be sliced by entity or has to be sliced by county.

#### Samples, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?spP AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2probe rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?spP rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2probe .
} LIMIT 201
```

#### Facilities, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?facilityP AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2probe rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2probe kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityP .
  ?facilityP fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeP .
  ?industryCodeP a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

} LIMIT 201
```

#### Water bodies, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?waterBodyP AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2probe rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo ?waterBodyP .
  ?waterBodyP rdf:type hyf:HY_WaterBody .

} LIMIT 201
```

#### Wells, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?wellP AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2probe rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo ?wellP .
  { ?wellP rdf:type il_isgs:ISGS-Well } UNION { ?wellP rdf:type me_mgs:MGS-Well }
} LIMIT 201
```

#### Aquifers, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?aquiferP AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2probe rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo ?aquiferP .
  ?aquiferP rdf:type gwml2:GW_Aquifer .

} LIMIT 201
```

#### Streams, on `federation`

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?streamP AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2probe rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2probe spatial:connectedTo ?streamP .
  ?streamP rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath .

} LIMIT 201
```
